Movie.title: Movie
Movie.description: Represents a movie or TV show with multiple video streaming servers

description.description: Brief summary or description of the movie

year.description: The release year of the movie

posterUrl.description: The URL of the movie poster image

bannerUrl.description: An optional banner image URL for the movie detail page header

isTrending.description: Flag to mark the movie as trending

views.description: Number of clicked sessions or movie views

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Represents a movie review or comment from an authenticated user

movieId.description: The ID of the target movie

userPhoto.description: Profile picture URL of the user

Favorite.title: Favorite
Favorite.description: Indicates a bookmarked or favorited movie linked to a user profile

Watchlist.title: Watchlist
Watchlist.description: Represents a movie in a user's watch list for later viewing

/movies/{movieId}.description: The movies and series collection managed by the site admin

/comments/{commentId}.description: Reviews and comments posted on movies

/favorites/{favId}.description: Saved favorite items of registered users

/watchlist/{watchId}.description: List of pending items to watch later
